newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia signs pact to make electronic purse - paper.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia signs pact to make electronic purse - paper.

text.p: Malaysia unveiled a plan in London on Wednesday to manufacture the world's first electronic purse, the New Straits Times (NST) newspaper reported on Thursday.
The credit card-sized device is intended to act as means of storing personal data including health and finances, said the NST in a report from London.
The three companies expected to jointly develop the card are Malaysia's T.L. Technology Research (M) Sdn Bhd, Britain's E-pass International Ltd and Iris Securities, said the NST.
The announcement was made at a signing ceremony in London to drum up support for Malaysia's Multimedia Super Corridor, a high-technology zone south of Kuala Lumpur, said the NST.
